def: An organ in which the ova are developed in certain Turbellaria.
Of or pertaining to Tagliacozzi, a Venetian surgeon; as, theTagliacotian operation, a method of rhinoplasty described by him.[Also Taliacotian, and Tagliacozzian.]
A form of divorce, among the ancient Romans, in which a cakewas used. See Confarreation.
The woods, underbrush, etc., which shelter and conceal game;covert; as, to beat a cover; to ride to cover.
Having lost, or tending to lose, inflections by phonetic decay;as, anaptotic languages.
Pertaining to, or of the nature of, edema; affected with edema.
To hasp or faster up; to close; as, sleep uphasps the eyes.[R.] Stanyhurst.
